about.title: About Vadodara Krushi Mitra
about.headline: Empowering Vadodara District's Farmers & Urban Cultivators
about.missionText: Vadodara Krushi Mitra bridges the vital gap between agronomic soil science, area-specific vegetable cultivation, and APMC mandi market economics for Vadodara District.
about.coverageText: Covering 17 major rural, peri-urban, and urban zones across Vadodara City, Padra, Karjan, Dabhoi, Savli, and Waghodia talukas, connected directly with the district's 4 major wholesale APMC yards.
about.partnersText: Designed for farmers, commercial growers, terrace gardeners, agritech researchers, and APMC market participants.

disclaimer.text: Recommendations are indicative and should be verified with local soil testing and agricultural experts before commercial cultivation.
disclaimer.demoText: APMC mandi prices shown in this prototype are demonstration figures for technical showcase purposes. Always check the official APMC display board or secretary's office for certified bidding figures.
